blind.description: A stylized fantasy monster nest containing three large speckled eggs in its central hollow. The nest is constructed from thick intertwined brown logs and branches, reinforced with animal bones, torn red fabric, green leaves, and scavenged steel armor including battered shields with red heraldry, shoulder guards, and gauntlet pieces. Surfaces are solid, chunky, and stylized for game use, with no floating shards or unrendered artifacts. The underside rests directly on the floor without an extra pedestal or plinth.
blind.from_above: A circular ring composed of logs, bones, and armor fragments framing an inner bedding with three large oval speckled eggs resting in a tight cluster.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 1.5 to 2 feet tall (around 1/3 the height of the figure) and roughly 4 to 4.5 feet wide in diameter (about 3/4 the figure's height).
